title: tanacetum yoshinaganthum
intro: Tanacetum yoshinaganthum, commonly known as Japanese Tansy, is a flowering plant in the sunflower family, characterized by its fern-like leaves and small yellow flowers. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, making it useful in treating wounds, skin conditions, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Tanacetum yoshinaganthum are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms of colds and flu. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, such as yoshinanolide and yoshinanolidone, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
